title: Long Field
instruments: fingerpicked acoustic guitar, upright bass, brushes
lyrics:
[verse]
My father's hands were maps of where he'd been
Every line a season he worked in
[chorus]
And the long field goes on
Longer than a name
Everyone I love is gone
Down the same long lane
note: Vocal named once and not described further - measured recipe: naming takes intelligibility 10%% -> 90%%, describing the mix drops it to 30%%.
